nodes.label: SorinFlow Divar Scraper
nodes.rationale: Enterprise-grade scraping system for Divar.ir with anti-detection, authenticated phone extraction, and real-time analytics

nodes.label: Divar.ir Platform
nodes.rationale: Iran's largest classified ads platform — the scraping target

nodes.label: OTP-Based Divar Login
nodes.rationale: Phone authentication against Divar is required to extract listing phone numbers; cookies persist the session

nodes.label: Anti-Detection / Stealth Mode
nodes.rationale: Stealth browser automation plus proxy rotation and rate limiting to avoid Divar bot blocking

nodes.label: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
nodes.rationale: RTL Persian UI for job tracking, city-wise statistics and export

nodes.label: Persian Install Guide (Docker-only setup)
nodes.rationale: Only Docker Desktop and Git required — Python/PostgreSQL/Redis all run inside Docker

nodes.label: Property Field Extraction Fix (area/rooms ordering)
nodes.rationale: Specific Persian patterns (متراژ کل, تعداد اتاق) must be checked before general ones (متراژ, اتاق) or the wrong field wins; new columns land_area/built_area/frontage/usage_type/building_age added

nodes.label: CD Deploy Job (self-hosted runner, k3s)
nodes.rationale: Datacenter blocks inbound SSH from foreign IPs, so a GitHub-hosted runner cannot reach the server; a self-hosted runner on the box connects outbound to GitHub and pulls the image into k3s containerd

nodes.label: properties Table Schema
nodes.rationale: Central table: divar_id, price fields, area/land_area/built_area, rooms, amenities flags, city/category FKs

nodes.label: Backend Deployment (sorinflow.com, NodePort 30080)
nodes.rationale: imagePullPolicy IfNotPresent because CI imports the image directly into the node's containerd

nodes.label: Traefik Let's Encrypt ACME Resolver
nodes.rationale: Uses k3s built-in Traefik HelmChartConfig instead of cert-manager — no external image needed

nodes.label: Persian Dashboard User Guide
nodes.rationale: Step-by-step end-user manual for sorinflow.com: dashboard login (24h session, optional TOTP), Divar auth, scraping, CRM, proxies, user management

nodes.label: CRM — Leads, Tasks, Contacts, Deals
nodes.rationale: Sales-tracking layer that converts scraped listings into customers

nodes.label: SorinFlow Landing Page (WebGL nebula, Vazirmatn)
nodes.rationale: Holographic-particle marketing page positioning SorinFlow as scraper + CRM + agent-performance platform

nodes.label: Infinity-House Logo (favicon.svg)
nodes.rationale: 3D gabled house with an infinity mark on the wall — real estate plus continuous data flow, indigo/violet/cyan gradient brand palette

nodes.label: Python Dependency Manifest
nodes.rationale: FastAPI+uvicorn, SQLAlchemy async+asyncpg, Playwright+BeautifulSoup, Redis, Celery+Flower, pyotp TOTP, loguru, prometheus-client
